HttpRpcServer and file_query carry the same guards; the router is mounted once.

NC-010.reason: PR-025 duplicate. SingleInstanceManager creates the lock atomically (openSync 'wx'), decides staleness by pid liveness (process.kill(pid, 0)) plus hostname/start time, stops its heartbeat when the lock is no longer its own, and unlinks only its own lock (or a verified stale one). The owner's scratchpad lock check covers takeover, refusal, the foreign-takeover heartbeat and foreign-release cases.
